Primary emit: Scripture of Elidinis (skilling Conduit of Souls; Bik notes incorrectly bagged Elidinis with combat scriptures) + Gate of Elidinis skilling-boss hub (source geography; memory-dowser / runic-attuner already first-class without a parent hub). policy.region_rule: region_hint is primary geography. region_hints lists support pressure. required_regions only when every listed region is a hard gate. Never put multi-region/cross-region/global in region fields.
policy.duplicate_guard: Grep-confirmed PRESENT — do not re-emit: misthalin:scripture-of-bik, desert:powder-of-burials, desert:powder-of-penance, desert:hets-oasis-prayer-powders, desert:citharede-abbey-illuminated-books, fremennik:god-books-horror-from-the-deep, misthalin:fort-chapel, misthalin:memory-dowser, misthalin:runic-attuner, multi-region:prayer-training-infrastructure-stack, morytania:ectofuntus-prayer-worship.
policy.scripture_skilling_rule: Only pocket scriptures whose activated passive is a skilling effect enter regional-skilling. Combat-only EGWD/Menaphite scriptures stay combat catalogs.
skip_combat_scriptures: Scripture of Jas — Time Rift combat damage store (Kerapac / Nodon Front)
Scripture of Wen — Sheer Cold combat AoE (Arch-Glacor / Glacor Front)
Scripture of Ful — Gladiator's Rage combat buff (TzKal-Zuk / TzekHaar Front)
Scripture of Amascut — Devourer's Corruption combat (Sanctum of Rebirth)
No 'Scripture of Aminishi' exists on wiki (Arc ED1 is Temple of Aminishi combat dungeon, not a pocket book)
Eclipsed Soul prayer codex / overhead — pure combat crit/heal prayer from Gate uniques; combat/prayer datasets only
Erethdor's grimoire / chaotic grimoire — combat pocket paths
policy.skip_present_godbook_illumination: Base god books (fremennik:god-books-horror-from-the-deep) and Citharede illumination (desert:citharede-abbey-illuminated-books) already first-class — no residual re-emit.
policy.skip_present_fort_chapel: misthalin:fort-chapel already first-class (post-Feb-2026 200/250/300% tier ladder + tier-3 prayer-book swap).
policy.skip_present_powders: desert:powder-of-burials and desert:powder-of-penance already first-class. Combat powders (defence / protection / item protection) are not skilling Prayer training residuals.
policy.no_trade_rule: Ironman permanent pocket skilling books, skilling-boss infrastructure gates, and Desert-produced Prayer consumables that change no-trade training throughput.
policy.rate_rule: No invented XP/hour or drop rates. Unlock state, charge model, soul XP structure as wiki fractions of small lamps, and region pressure only.
